assertion.statement: For B nonzero, rational solubility of the exact pole polynomial excludes a negative odd valuation of B at every prime outside{2,3,5,7,13}.
assertion.objects: The eleven-witness polynomial Qpole, Boolean bits, signed divisor m of2730, A=mB, H=A(A−B²), and the two elliptic-curve points supplied by its equations.
assertion.hypotheses: B is nonzero and all defining equations of Qpole hold overQ; p lies outside the fixed exceptional set.
assertion.quantifiers: Every rational solution and every prime outside the fixed exceptional set.
assertion.parameter_range: One-sided obstruction only; no small-positive or denominator-square condition is used here.
assertion.uniformity: Uniform for all witnesses and all such primes.
assertion.normalizations: Both point abscissas are in the squareclass A. Square scaling of the chosen even-valuation parameter preserves oddness of the abscissa valuation.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion at B=0 or at exceptional primes. This does not prove pole completeness or any converse.
assertion.limit_order: Use the Boolean and inverse equations to obtain actual nondegenerate points; assume an odd negative valuation ofB; compute valuations ofA,H; scale the even-valuation curve parameter to a unit and contradict squareness of its cubic.

assertion.statement: For an elliptic curve overQ with full rational2-torsion, two-Selmer dimension3 implies full2-infinity Selmer corank1 without assuming finite Sha.
assertion.objects: The finite Kummer sequence, rankr, cofinitely generated Sha[2-infinity]=(Q2/Z2)^t plus finite F and its canonical principal-polarization pairing.
assertion.hypotheses: Full rational2-torsion and dimF2 Sel2=3; finite-generation/Kummer structure and the alternating nondegenerate Cassels–Tate pairing on the finite quotient by the maximal divisible subgroup are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve overQ meeting these hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Full2-primary Selmer corank, not Mordell–Weil rank alone.
assertion.uniformity: No quantitative bound or uniform finiteness assumption.
assertion.constants: r+dim Sha[2]=1; dimF[2] is even; hence F=0 and r+t=1.
assertion.normalizations: The divisible subgroup is the actual maximal divisible subgroup because every divisible subgroup maps trivially to finiteF. Pair finite primary cyclic factors, not the restricted pairing onF[2].
assertion.exceptional_cases: Sha may have a nonzero divisible part. The pairing onF[2] need not be nondegenerate and is not used. Pairing source validation remains separate.
assertion.limit_order: Apply finite Kummer dimensions; decompose the cofinitely generated2-primary group; use alternation on its finite quotient to forceF=0; apply the full Kummer sequence for corank.
